subsystem_shelled_tray_recycled_asa.structural_purpose: Lightened cored retail display grid. Printed at zero fan speed to eliminate stress warp. Integrated bottom outgas grooves handle expanding styrene vectors flat against the build plate safely.

subsystem_branding_badge_2_piece_pmma.structural_purpose: Solvent-proof 2-piece logo plates. Base plate and raised embossed lettering are printed as separate supportless objects on the same plate, entirely avoiding single-nozzle mid-layer color swap bottlenecks.
